about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která provozuje Facebook, Instagram a WhatsApp a vydělává hlavně na reklamě.

about.label: Intel
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units and related products for business and consumer markets.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce procesorů pro počítače a servery, který vyrábí čipy i na zakázku.

about.label: Merck KGaA
about.summary: German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, with about 60,000 employees and a presence in 66 countries. Merck was founded in 1668 and is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company, as well as one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally.
about.summary_cs: Německá vědecko-technologická firma, která vyrábí léky, laboratorní potřeby a materiály pro elektroniku.

about.label: Palantir Technologies
about.summary: American publicly traded company that develops data integration and analytics software.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává platformy pro analýzu dat a umělou inteligenci vládám, armádám i firmám.

about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: CrowdStrike
about.summary: American cybersecurity technology company based in Austin, Texas. It provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která chrání počítače a servery, sleduje hrozby a pomáhá řešit kybernetické útoky.

about.label: Apple Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí iPhony, Macy, iPady a další elektroniku a prodává k nim software a služby.

about.label: Visa Inc.
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Visa, největší na světě.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, největší internetový obchod na světě a největší poskytovatel cloudových služeb (AWS).

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Mastercard
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York.
industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
industry_cs: finanční služby, kromě pojišťovnictví a penzijního financování
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Mastercard.

about.label: Netflix, Inc.
about.summary: American media company founded on August 29, 1997, by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in Scotts Valley, California, and currently based in Los Gatos, California, with production offices and stages at the Los Angeles–based Hollywood studios and the Albuquerque Studios.
about.summary_cs: Americká streamovací služba s filmy a seriály, která sama vyrábí velkou část svého obsahu.

about.label: Texas Instruments
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The company's focus is on developing analog chips and embedded processors, which account for more than 80% of its revenue.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce analogových čipů a procesorů pro průmysl a auta.

about.label: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was one of the first biotech firms to use an explicit strategy of rational drug design rather than combinatorial chemistry.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na cystickou fibrózu a další vážná onemocnění.

about.label: Analog Devices
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company specializing in data conversion, signal processing, and power management technology, headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americká polovodičová firma specializovaná na převod a zpracování signálu a řízení napájení.

about.label: Qualcomm
about.summary: American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing, including next-generation mobile networks, smart devices, and semiconductors — such as mobile processors and artificial intelligence chips.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro mobily a bezdrátovou komunikaci a licencuje své patenty.

about.label: Oracle Corporation
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Co-founded in Santa Clara, California, in 1977 by Bob Miner, Ed Oates, and current chairman of the board and chief technology officer Larry Ellison, Oracle is among the 50 largest companies in the world by market cap, and ranked 52nd on the Forbes Global 2000 as of 2026.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává databáze, podnikový software a cloudové služby.

about.label: Fortinet
about.summary: American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products including firewalls, endpoint security and intrusion detection systems.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a další ochranu sítí a zařízení.

about.label: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
about.summary: American biotechnology company headquartered in Westchester County, New York. Originally focused on neurotrophic factors and their regenerative capabilities, giving rise to its present name; the company has since expanded operations into the study of both cytokine and tyrosine kinase receptors, which gave rise to their first product, which is a VEGF-trap.
about.summary_cs: Americká biotechnologická firma, která vyvíjí léky například na oční choroby a astma.

about.label: Intuitive Surgical
about.summary: American biotechnology company that develops, manufactures, and markets robotic products designed to improve clinical outcomes of patients through minimally invasive surgery, most notably with the da Vinci Surgical System.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí chirurgické roboty da Vinci pro miniinvazivní operace.

about.label: Salesforce
about.summary: American enterprise software company headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, největší dodavatel cloudového softwaru pro řízení vztahů se zákazníky (CRM).

about.label: Moderna
about.summary: American pharmaceutical and biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, that focuses on RNA therapeutics, primarily mRNA vaccines. These vaccines use a copy of a molecule called messenger RNA to carry instructions for proteins to produce an immune response.
about.summary_cs: Americká biotechnologická firma, která vyvíjí mRNA vakcíny a léky, například vakcínu proti covidu-19.

about.label: Western Digital
about.summary: American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, the company is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce pevných disků a úložišť dat.

about.label: ServiceNow
about.summary: American software company that supplies cloud computing platforms for the creation and management of automated business workflows.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, jejíž cloudová platforma automatizuje firemní procesy, třeba IT podporu nebo personalistiku.

about.label: Adobe
about.summary: American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, autor Photoshopu, Acrobatu a dalších nástrojů pro tvorbu a úpravu obsahu.

about.label: Snowflake Inc.
about.summary: American cloud-based artificial intelligence data platform company founded in San Mateo, California, and headquartered in Menlo Park.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudová platforma firmám ukládá a analyzuje data a pomáhá je využít pro umělou inteligenci.

about.label: Equinix
about.summary: American multinational internet and data center company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It specialized in internet connectivity and data center colocation centers, commonly known as carrier hotels, until the company converted to a real estate investment trust in January 2015.
about.summary_cs: Americký provozovatel datových center po celém světě, ve kterých si firmy pronajímají místo pro servery a propojení do sítí. Je to realitní fond (REIT).

about.label: Ametek
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate and global designer and manufacturer of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices with headquarters in the United States and over 150 sites worldwide.
about.summary_cs: Americký konglomerát, který navrhuje a vyrábí elektronické přístroje a elektromechanická zařízení.

about.label: Baker Hughes
about.summary: American global energy technology company co-headquartered in Houston, Texas and London, UK. As one of the world's largest oil field services, industrial and energy technology companies, it provides products and services to the oil and gas industry for exploration and production, as well as other energy and industrial applications. It operates in over 120 co
about.summary_cs: Americká energetická technologická firma, jeden z největších dodavatelů služeb a zařízení pro těžbu ropy a plynu i další průmysl.

about.label: Okta
about.summary: American identity and access management company based in San Francisco. It provides cloud software that helps companies manage and secure user authentication into applications, and for developers to build identity controls into applications, websites, web services, and devices.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává cloudový software pro bezpečné přihlašování a správu uživatelských účtů.

about.label: Digital Realty Trust
about.summary: Real estate investment trust that owns, operates, and invests in carrier-neutral data centers across the world.
about.summary_cs: Realitní fond (REIT), který vlastní a provozuje datová centra po celém světě.

about.label: Incyte
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical company with headquarters in Wilmington, Delaware. The company currently operates manufacturing and R&D locations in North America, Europe, and Asia.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na rakovinu a záněty.

about.label: Strategy
about.summary: American company that provides business intelligence and mobile software.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která prodává analytický software, ale hlavně nakupuje a drží bitcoin – je jeho největším firemním vlastníkem.

about.label: Twilio
about.summary: American cloud communications company based in San Francisco, California, which provides programmable communication tools for making and receiving phone calls, sending and receiving text messages, and performing other communication functions using its web service APIs.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudové nástroje umožňují aplikacím posílat SMS, volat a komunikovat se zákazníky.

about.label: Zscaler
about.summary: American cloud security company based in San Jose, California. The company offers cloud-based services to protect enterprise networks and data.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudové služby chrání firemní sítě a data.

about.label: NetApp
about.summary: American data infrastructure company that provides unified data storage, integrated data services, and cloud operations solutions to enterprise customers.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává úložiště dat a software pro správu dat v datových centrech a cloudu.
